title: Cheese
lede: Before Cheese sends a message, opens a task, decides a review or manages members for you, it checks whether you asked for that action. If you didn't, it asks you to confirm in the panel first. Only you can change this page.

always.title: Always confirm
always.desc: Cheese asks you to confirm these actions every time before taking them.

words.title: Notes
words.desc: Cheese takes these into account when deciding whether to ask you to confirm.
words.allowHint: For example: answering questions in channels I run

recent.title: Recent actions
recent.empty: Cheese hasn't taken any action others can see for you yet.
